Res.Caption: Constrained Mode
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether the Release Gate and Visual Boards consider this Release Group to be capacity constrained.

Res.Caption: Auto Assign Task Age
Res.FullDescription: The duration a workflow can spend in a buffer (using the buffer's Department and Branch hours) before it becomes eligible for auto-assignment. This age overrides the Component Age and is overridden by the Capability Age. 000:00 indicates assignment immediately after release.

Res.Caption: Reset Task Penetration Outside Group
Res.FullDescription: When Reset Task Penetration is true in the Registry, this flag defines whether task reset is applicable to a task assigned or re-assigned to a resource which is outside the workflow's release group.

Res.Caption: Reset Task Penetration Inside Group
Res.FullDescription: When Reset Task Penetration is true in the Registry, this flag defines whether task reset is applicable to a task assigned or re-assigned to a resource which is inside the workflow's release group.

Res.Caption: Reset Task Penetration Throttle Factor
Res.FullDescription: Defines the speed a task moves along the buffer after task reset until it catches up to its workflow's buffer penetration. This value is multiplied by the workflow's buffer penetration speed.

Res.Caption: Release Gate Mode
Res.FullDescription: Determines which mode the Release Gate will use to release workflows to this Release Group.

Res.Caption: Release When In Progress
Res.FullDescription: When enabled, the Release Gate will release any workflows that contain an active (working) task.
